summary: Game crashes when dispensing a shulker box from a dispenser - "java.lang.NullPointerException: Exception while ticking"
description: (1.16 Pre-Release 3) [^crash-2020-06-10_18.21.22-server.txt] Description: Exception while ticking java.lang.NullPointerException: Exception while ticking at bil.a(SourceFile:88) at gy.a(SourceFile:23) at gu.dispense(SourceFile:15) at bxc.a(SourceFile:89) at bxc.a(SourceFile:112) at cfi$a.a(SourceFile:865) at zd.b(SourceFile:596) at zd$$Lambda$3895/290764432.accept(Unknown Source) at bqn.b(SourceFile:84) at zd.a(SourceFile:351) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.b(SourceFile:873) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:813) at eox.a(SourceFile:93) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.v(SourceFile:672) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:256) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer$$Lambda$3883/2115162896.run(Unknown Source) at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:745)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings in Minecraft Java Edition 1.16 Pre-Release 3.
2. Place a dispenser on the ground and load it with a shulker box.
3. Power the dispenser to dispense the shulker box.
4. Observe that the game crashes immediately after the dispensing attempt.
5. Note that upon re-entering the world, the dispenser is still powered but contains the same shulker box item.
6. Take a screenshot of the crashed state and gather the `debug` folder for further analysis.
7. Confirm the issue persists by repeating steps 2-5 multiple times to ensure consistency.
Observed Behavior: The game crashes when attempting to dispense a shulker box from a dispenser, resulting in a `java.lang.NullPointerException: Exception while ticking` error. This issue occurs specifically in version 1.16 Pre-Release 3. The crash happens immediately upon dispensing the shulker box and persists even after logging back into the world, where the dispenser remains powered but retains the shulker box item. In some cases, the shulker box is duplicated, appearing both placed and still within the dispenser. This behavior appears to be related to the dispenser calling `BlockItem#place` to place the shulker box, which leads to a null player reference when checking if the player is in creative mode, thus causing the NullPointerException. The problem can occur regardless of whether there are data packs installed or not and seems to be exacerbated by areas with significant redstone mechanisms.
Expected Behavior: When dispensing a shulker box from a dispenser, the game should not crash and the shulker box should be properly placed in the world without any duplication or residual items remaining in the dispenser. This behavior should occur consistently across different scenarios and environments.
